description: Migrate a billing and subscription management system from Stripe Billing to Chargebee for a SaaS platform with 50K subscribers. The migration must follow: data export from Stripe (customers, subscriptions, invoices, credit notes), data import to Chargebee (map Stripe subscription state to Chargebee plan/subscription model), proration handling (verify mid-cycle plan changes calculate proration correctly in Chargebee), grace/dunning migration (map Stripe's dunning workflow to Chargebee's retry rules — retry schedule, email templates, subscription cancellation on exhaustion), reconciliation (verify total MRR, active subscription count, invoice totals match between Stripe and Chargebee), and cutover (switch the application to use Chargebee for new billing events, keep Stripe as read-only for historical data). A rollback plan must exist (revert to Stripe Billing for new events). Risk factors: subscription state mapping errors (active vs trial vs past_due), proration calculation differences, dunning behavior changes affecting churn, and tax calculation differences (Stripe Tax vs Chargebee Tax). Tools available: Chargebee API, Stripe API, Python/Node scripts, reconciliation SQL, feature flags, monitoring.
